full_name: INE Censo de Poblacion y Viviendas 2021 (Sistema de Difusion de los Censos - SDC21)

features.definition: Number of households (SDC21 table 'hog', metric SHOGARES). Live-verified nationwide total 18,539,214 matches INE's published 18,539,223 Censo 2021 household count.
Persons whose highest completed education is primary education or less (SDC21 per.ppal table, ID_ESREAL_GR5 category 'Educacion primaria e inferior').

category_value: Primera etapa de Educación Secundaria y similar
Segunda etapa de Educación Secundaria y Educación Postsecundaria no Superior
features.definition: Persons whose highest completed education is lower or upper secondary / post-secondary non-tertiary education (SDC21 per.ppal table, ID_ESREAL_GR5, both secondary categories summed).

Persons whose highest completed education is tertiary/higher education (SDC21 per.ppal table, ID_ESREAL_GR5 category 'Educacion Superior'). INE's 5-level ID_ESREAL_GR5 does not separate university from other tertiary, so educationOtherTertiaryPopulation is intentionally not implemented here -- see module docstring.

Economically active population (SDC21 per.ppal table, ID_RELA2 category 'Activo'). Live-verified: equals employedResidents + unemployedResidents (ID_RELA breakdown) to within INE's disclosure-control rounding.
Employed residents (SDC21 per.ppal table, ID_RELA category 'Ocupado/a').
Unemployed residents actively seeking work (SDC21 per.ppal table, ID_RELA category 'Parado/a').

Residents born abroad (SDC21 per.ppal table, ID_LUGAR_NAC_EXT_N1 category 'Extranjero'). Live-verified nationwide total 7,254,795 abroad + 40,146,003 in Spain = 47,400,798, consistent with the other per.ppal breakdowns.
